tools.name: execute_python
tools.description: Execute Python code in the Ouroboros project directory. Use this to test code before registering it as a permanent tool, to read or modify files in the project, and to gain any capability you need. Returns stdout, stderr, exit_code.
tools.test_plan: Built-in tool covered by application tests.

tools.name: rollback_latest_checkpoint
tools.description: Restore the latest file mutation checkpoint created before an approved risky Python execution.

tools.name: register_tool
tools.description: Permanently register a new skill package directory or legacy Python file. Skill packages live under nucleus/tools/ and contain tool.py, schema.json, README.md, tests.py, and metadata.json.
Permanently register a tested Python file as a versioned tool. The file must live under nucleus/tools and include a test_command, test_plan, or sample_arguments.

filepath.description: Path under nucleus/tools, relative to nucleus (for example tools/my_skill or tools/my_tool.py)

tools.test_plan: Built-in tool covered by application tests.
